item.title: Iran's fight against aggressive enemies will continue until complete victory: Deputy speaker
item.description: Karaj, IRNA – Deputy Parliament Speaker Ali Nikzad says Iran remains determined to fight the foreign aggressors until complete victory, noting that the enemies do not yet know the Armed Forces and the people of the Islamic Republic.

item.title: Iran, Belarus reaffirm commitment to expanding bilateral cooperation

item.title: Pakistan reaffirms Iran’s right to peaceful nuclear energy
item.description: Islamabad, IRNA — Pakistan has reaffirmed that Iran, as a signatory to the Treaty on the Non-Proliferation of Nuclear Weapons (NPT), has a legitimate right to develop and use nuclear energy for peaceful purposes.

item.title: Iran condemns US sanctions on 27 Iranian airlines as ‘economic terrorism’
item.description: New York, IRNA — The Islamic Republic has condemned new US sanctions targeting 27 Iranian airlines and aviation-related entities, describing the measures as “economic terrorism” and “ collective punishment” that threaten civilian aviation safety and restrict the movement of millions of people.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86260146/Iran-condemns-US-sanctions-on-27-Iranian-airlines-as-economic

item.title: Iran rejects US claims, says Ansarallah makes its own decisions
item.description: Tehran, IRNA — Iran has rejected US Secretary of State Marco Rubio’s allegations of Iranian interference in Yemen, stressing that the Ansarallah movement is an independent Yemeni actor that makes its own decisions and does not operate as a proxy for any country.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Iran strongly rejects false claims contained in the statement issued at Arab League FM meeting
item.description: Tehran, IRNA — In a statement, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Islamic Republic of Iran rejected and condemned all the false claims and baseless accusations leveled against Iran in the final communiqué of the 166th session of the Arab League Council of Foreign Ministers.

item.title: Envoy: War and blockade part of same strategy to weaken Iran
item.description: London, IRNA – Ali Bahreini, head of the Permanent Mission of the Islamic Republic of Iran to the United Nations Office and other International Organizations in Geneva, has censured the United States over unilateral sanctions and warfare against the Islamic Republic, saying aggression and blockade are part of a broader strategy to undermine the independence of Iran.
item.content:encoded:
Original source: https://en.irna.ir/news/86260023/Envoy-War-and-blockade-part-of-same-strategy-to-weaken-Iran

London, IRNA – Ali Bahreini, head of the Permanent Mission of the Islamic Republic of Iran to the United Nations Office and other International Organizations in Geneva, has censured the United States over unilateral sanctions and warfare against the Islamic Republic, saying aggression and blockade are part of a broader strategy to undermine the independence of Iran.
